analysis.summary: MT-MPC applies metamorphic testing to compilers for secure multi-party computation, which translate high-level descriptions into low-level executables through several intermediate representations and many optimisations. The authors note no systematic understanding of these compilers' correctness existed. They propose three metamorphic relations tailored to MPC programs and check whether the compiler produces semantically equivalent executables. Across three industrial compilers they found 4,772 error-triggering inputs and traced thirteen bugs.
analysis.narrative: One citation, in a list of the software systems metamorphic testing has been applied to: databases, AI models and cyber-physical systems.
